nodes.label: About this demo
nodes.summary: A fictional roastery's wiki, to try browsing, the brain and questions before adding your own documents.

nodes.label: customers
nodes.description: Wholesale cafés, subscribers and the policies that apply to them.

nodes.label: Café Portello
nodes.summary: Wholesale customer since 2024: 18 kg a week of Aurora; wants training on decaf.

nodes.label: Refund policy
nodes.summary: Refunds within 30 days of delivery; damaged bags are replaced without sending them back.

nodes.label: Subscription churn, Q2 2026
nodes.summary: Churn was 6.1% a month in Q2 2026; people leave mostly because they have too much coffee, then because of price.

nodes.label: Wholesale café onboarding
nodes.summary: New cafés get a tasting, a 2 kg trial, a grinder calibration visit, and 30-day payment after three orders.

nodes.label: ideas
nodes.description: Proposals that are not decided yet.

nodes.label: Cold brew cans
nodes.summary: A pilot of 500 cans with a co-packer, if the shelf-life test passes.

nodes.label: Pause instead of cancel
nodes.summary: Offer a one- or two-month pause on the cancellation page, to keep subscribers who have too much coffee.

nodes.label: Roastery tours
nodes.summary: Saturday tours with a cupping session for 12 people at €15 each.

nodes.label: meetings
nodes.description: Minutes of team and board meetings, with their decisions.

nodes.label: Board meeting, June 2026
nodes.summary: Approved a study for a second roaster, a cold brew pilot and a part-time packer.

nodes.label: Pricing meeting, May 2026
nodes.summary: Retail up 8% and wholesale up 5% from 1 July; decaf keeps its margin; subscriptions keep their discount.

nodes.label: Weekly sync, 10 June 2026
nodes.summary: Packing is late on Tuesdays, the Guji lot has arrived, and two cafés asked for decaf training.

nodes.label: operations
nodes.description: How the roastery runs day to day.

nodes.label: roasting
nodes.description: Roast profiles, quality control and the roaster itself.

nodes.label: Aurora roast profile
nodes.summary: Charge at 205 °C, first crack at 9:10, drop at 11:30, with 1:45 of development.

nodes.label: Quality control and cupping
nodes.summary: Every batch is cupped the day after roasting; below 82 points a coffee is not sold as single origin.

nodes.label: Roaster maintenance
nodes.summary: Chaff cleaned weekly, exhaust monthly, burner serviced yearly; the roaster runs at 85% capacity.

nodes.label: Carriers and delivery times
nodes.summary: Parcel carrier for Italy in 1-2 days and the EU in 3-5; free shipping over €45 in Italy.

nodes.label: Subscription packing day
nodes.summary: Subscriptions are roasted on Monday, packed on Tuesday morning and shipped on Tuesday afternoon.

nodes.label: products
nodes.description: Coffees Lumen sells: blends, single origins and decaf, with their prices.

nodes.label: Aurora espresso blend
nodes.summary: House espresso: 60% Brazil Cerrado and 40% Ethiopia Guji, medium roast; the best seller.

nodes.label: Ethiopia Guji, seasonal single origin
nodes.summary: Washed Guji lot, floral and citrus, sold from March to August while the lot lasts.

nodes.label: Night Shift decaf
nodes.summary: Swiss Water decaf from Colombia Huila; 12% of subscription orders.

nodes.label: Price list from July 2026
nodes.summary: Retail and wholesale prices from 1 July 2026, after the rise in green coffee prices.

nodes.label: sourcing
nodes.description: Green coffee: importers, origins, contracts and how prices are fixed.

nodes.label: Andes Direct, importer
nodes.summary: Main importer for Brazil and Colombia lots: FOB contracts, payment at 60 days.

nodes.label: Green coffee price hedging
nodes.summary: Prices are fixed for six months on 70% of the expected volume; the rest is bought at market.

nodes.label: Guji washing station visit, February 2026
nodes.summary: Notes from the visit to the Guji washing station: capacity, cupping and the 2026 contract.
